items.q: What comic formats does TV Comic Book Reader support?
items.a: The app supports CBZ, ZIP, CBR, RAR, CB7, 7Z, CBT, and TAR comic archives on Android TV.

items.q: How can I import comics into the app?
items.a: You can use Web Import, WiFi Import, FTP Import, or open compatible comic archives shared from other apps.

items.q: Does Web Import require the same network as the TV?
items.a: No. Web Import uses a temporary token and QR code, so the sending device does not need to be on the same local network.

items.q: What is WiFi Import best for?
items.a: WiFi Import is best when your sending device and TV are on the same network and you want a quick local upload page.

items.q: Can the app remember my reading progress?
items.a: Yes. TV Comic Book Reader saves your progress for each comic and remembers settings such as zoom, rotation, background color, and night mode.

items.q: Is there a gallery view for page browsing?
items.a: Yes. You can open a gallery or strip view, browse pages visually, and jump back into the reader from the selected page.

items.q: Can I bookmark comic pages?
items.a: Yes. You can bookmark pages, open a bookmark list for the current comic, or browse all saved bookmarks from the dedicated bookmarks screen.

items.q: Can I customize the reading view?
items.a: Yes. The app includes zoom controls, fit mode, rotation, night mode or color inversion, and custom background color selection.

items.q: Can I delete imported comics and clear storage data?
items.a: Yes. Long-press imported files to view details or delete them, and use the settings screen to clear comics, thumbnails, and bookmarks.

items.q: Does the app work offline?
items.a: Yes. Once your comics are available on the device, you can browse and read them offline.

items.q: What is TV Comic Book Reader?
items.a: TV Comic Book Reader is an Android TV app for importing, browsing, and reading comic archives with remote-friendly controls.

items.q: Which comic formats are supported?
items.a: The app supports CBZ, ZIP, CBR, RAR, CB7, 7Z, CBT, and TAR comic archives.

items.q: How can I add comics to the app?
items.a: You can import comics with Web Import, WiFi Import, FTP Import, or by opening supported files shared from other apps.

items.q: Does Web Import need the same WiFi network?
items.a: No. Web Import uses a temporary token and QR code, so it can work without sharing the same local network.

items.q: Does the app remember my progress?
items.a: Yes. The app saves reading progress per comic and remembers view settings like zoom, rotation, night mode, and background color.

items.q: Can I browse pages visually?
items.a: Yes. The app includes both a thumbnail-based comic library and a gallery or strip view for pages inside a comic.

items.q: Can I bookmark pages?
items.a: Yes. You can bookmark pages, review bookmarks for the current comic, and browse all saved bookmarks from a dedicated screen.

items.q: Can I change the page display?
items.a: Yes. You can zoom, change fit mode, rotate pages, enable night mode, and choose a custom background color.

items.q: Can I delete imported comics?
items.a: Yes. Long-press a comic in the library for file actions such as viewing details or deleting imported files.

items.q: Is the app available in multiple languages?
items.a: Yes. TV Comic Book Reader includes translations for many languages, including Arabic, Chinese, French, German, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese, and Indonesian.
